name: XmlSchema
description: Represents an XML schema contained by an XmlMap object.
remarks: Use the Item method to return an XmlSchema object from the XmlSchemas collection. Use the Namespace property to return the target namespace for a schema. Use the XML property to return the XML contents of a schema.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Namespace
properties.description: Returns an XmlNamespace object that represents the target namespace for the specified schema. Read-only.

properties.name: XML
properties.description: Returns a String value that represents the content of the specified schema.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns a String value that represents the friendly name used to identify an XML schema in an XmlMap object.
